paper_title: Pulsar Polarization Array Limits on Ultralight Axion-like Dark Matter
coupling_convention: g_agammagamma in GeV^-1 (plot shows log10(g_agamma/GeV^-1); values de-logged)
notes: First pulsar polarization array (PPA) analysis using 22 MSPs from PPTA DR3, constraining the ALDM Chern-Simons (axion-photon) coupling g_agamma via cosmic birefringence of pulsar linear polarization. Paper explicitly states 95% upper limits of ~10^-13.5 to 10^-12.2 GeV^-1 over the mass range 10^-22 to 10^-21 eV, assuming local ALDM density rho_0 = 0.4 GeV/cm^3. Endpoints taken from text; intermediate point interpolated assuming the stated linear scaling of the limit with m_a for m_a >~ 1/T_obs. Full exclusion curve in Fig. 2 spans ~10^-23 to 10^-19 eV but numerical values are only quoted in text for the 10^-22 to 10^-21 eV range. This is a measured limit (Bayesian upper limit), not a projection. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 55)) | Vision: Traced the red solid 'Full-corr' curve (full-correlation signal model with ionospheric subtraction) in Fig. 2 top panel of fig_00, which is the paper's headline 95% CL limit. Curve scales as m^-2 below 1/T_obs (~1e-23 eV), minimum g~2e-14 near 1e-23 eV, rises roughly linearly with mass, with a peak near 1 yr timescale (~1.2e-22 eV) and strong oscillations above ~4.5e-20 eV (1-day timescale), where sharp spikes reach ~1e-9 GeV^-1.
